protocol.training: Both fitted arms: same complete-event rows, 3 seeds, 200 epochs, weather loss weight 1, residual penalty 0; no hyperparameter/checkpoint selection
protocol.trade_filter: 5–95 cent decision market probability, applied only AFTER complete-event inference; 4c minimum net edge; unchanged bankroll caps/fees
protocol.scenarios: Same quote optimistic; next-hour stale forecast at 0 and +2c; no historical depth; $1000 initial bankroll
protocol.evaluation: Previously inspected validation only. No reserved test loaded. No promotion or automatic live change.
protocol.hypothesis: Event head removes mass error; compare forecast/calibration/trading separately. Binary projection isolates a cheaper coherence-only change.
